title: CyberBattleChain-v0 public run plan
description: Authoring input for the selected public CyberBattleSim protocol. Carries the episode/turn/termination control and the four descriptive stochastic controls that RAES SDL excludes. The stochastic controls are descriptive only: the public evaluator drops the seed bindings, so no executable random-stream binding is claimed and the determinism loss is retained.

episode_control.termination_rule: After each attacker and defender step, evaluate in precedence order: (1) attacker goal reached or defender SLA broken -> terminate with the winning reward; (2) else defender eviction goal reached -> terminate with the losing reward; (3) else continue. Gym always returns truncated=false; the evaluator iteration cutoff is not Gym truncation.
episode_control.description: Source-native termination causes stay distinct from the evaluator cutoff and from Gym terminated/truncated.

stochastic_controls.description: CyberBattleEnv.reset(seed=20260729). Lost: the public evaluator calls reset without forwarding a seed. Descriptive only; no executable binding.
env.action_space.seed(20260729). Not bound by the public notebook. Descriptive only; no executable binding.
random.seed(20260729) for the defender's Python random calls. Not bound by the public notebook. Descriptive only; no executable binding.
numpy.random.seed(20260729) for defender and baseline NumPy calls. Not bound by the public notebook. Descriptive only; no executable binding.
